<?php
$inputString = "";
$currentLine = 0;

$stdin = fopen('php://stdin', 'r');
while (!feof($stdin)) {
    $inputString .= fread($stdin, 8192);
}
fclose($stdin);

$inputString = array_map('trim', explode("\n", trim($inputString)));

function readLine() {
    global $inputString, $currentLine;
    return $inputString[$currentLine++];
}

function main() {
    $parts = explode(" ", readLine());
    $total = (int)$parts[0];
    $front = (int)$parts[1];
    $back = (int)$parts[2];
    
    $diff = $total - $front;

    if ($diff > $back) {
        echo $back + 1 . "\n";
    } else {
        echo $diff . "\n";
    }
}

main();
?>
